assumptions: Supplier SUP-A will confirm delivery on 2026-09-27 upon payment of the $450.00 expedite fee.
important_factors: Recommendation to buy 800 units exceeds the available budget of $10,000.00 ($12,000.00 from SUP-A, $14,000.00 from SUP-B) and is infeasible.
Existing purchase order PO-501 for 2,000 units is already confirmed for 2026-10-01 delivery.
Stockout gap of 400 total unmet units occurs from 2026-09-27 to 2026-09-30.
Expediting PO-501 by 4 days to 2026-09-27 completely eliminates all 400 units of unmet demand for an expedite fee of $450.00.
Expedite fee of $450.00 exceeds the $250.00 autonomy limit, requiring buyer approval, but remains fully feasible within the $10,000.00 budget limit.
args.rationale:
The recommendation to purchase 800 units is rejected because ordering 800 units costs $12,000.00 (SUP-A) or $14,000.00 (SUP-B), both breaching the available budget limit of $10,000.00. Furthermore, additional volume is unnecessary because open order PO-501 already provides 2,000 units from SUP-A, currently scheduled for delivery on 2026-10-01.

Without intervention, inventory runs out on 2026-09-27, creating a 400-unit shortage across 4 days (2026-09-27 to 2026-09-30). Expediting PO-501 by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 resolves the shortage entirely, reducing total unmet demand from 400 units to 0 units. The expedite fee of $450.00 is well within the available budget of $10,000.00 and peak storage occupancy remains at 60 m³ (within the 200 m³ limit). Because the expedite fee of $450.00 exceeds the buyer autonomy limit of $250.00, buyer approval is required.

important_factors: Baseline projection shows 600 unmet units (from 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-14) following the partial confirmation of PO-501 (1,200 confirmed, 800 cancelled).
The recommended purchase of 800 units costs $12,000.00 from SUP-A, which exceeds the available budget of $9,550.00 by $2,450.00.
Modifying the purchase quantity to 600 units from SUP-A costs $9,000.00, remaining within the available budget of $9,550.00 while completely eliminating all 600 unmet units.
args.rationale: Following the partial confirmation of PO-501 (1,200 units confirmed for 2026-09-27 delivery, 800 units cancelled), baseline inventory (1,000 usable units on hand) plus PO-501 yields 2,200 total units against 2,800 units of projected 28-day demand. This leaves a residual exposure of 600 unmet units between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-14. The system's 800-unit recommendation would cost $12,000.00 from SUP-A ($15.00/unit), which breaches the hard budget limit ($9,550.00 available) by $2,450.00. Modifying the order to 600 units from SUP-A satisfies lead time requirements (arriving 2026-09-24), complies with MOQ (500) and pack size (50), costs $9,000.00 (within budget), and fully eliminates the 600-unit shortage.
